**Gate 3, round 3 (reviewer-36-r3): Red, 1 Blocking, 8 Important, 10 Suggestion.** Report posted by the master. This round's brief did not yet have the 'focus on what changed' rule.
## 1. Correctness and edge cases
**B1. `HEADING` backtracks in cubic time: one line of the untrusted body hangs the command.** `packages/factory-tools/src/issue.ts:32` (`/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*#*\s*$/`). It runs on every body line at `src/issue.ts:97`. The lazy `.+?`, followed by two adjacent `\s*` around `#*`, retries every split of a whitespace run at every position.
